Body Clues

A personalized way to notice what your body is telling you, figure out what it might mean, and keep track of what helps. Designed by the occupational therapists at Cultivate Play for kids, teens and adults.

Email me when it launches

How it works

Notice it. Wonder about it. Find what helps.

Each check-in takes about a minute. Curiosity comes first: there are no right answers and nothing to keep up with.

What's inside

Built for real families

Body Clues grows with each person, from a first check-in to a toolkit they can share.

Pictures or words

Picture tiles and simple words for kids, or clear everyday wording for teens and adults. Every screen can be read aloud.

Patterns over time

See which feelings and needs each body clue has been linked to, which clues show up together, and when and where they tend to happen.

A summary for the care team

Make a PDF of check-in patterns to share with a therapist, teacher or doctor, only when your family chooses.

Profiles for the whole family

Siblings and grown-ups each get their own check-ins and settings. A passcode lock keeps a child's settings the way you set them.

Motivation without pressure

Badges for exploring, discoveries and a friendly buddy. No streaks, nothing taken away, and no rewards for "calm" answers.

Made to include everyone

A customizable body picture with different hair styles and mobility aids, and body clues that glow without assuming a skin color.

Our approach

Curiosity, not compliance

Body Clues treats every sensation as information worth exploring, never as a problem to fix or a behavior to correct. It's neurodiversity-affirming, follows each person's lead, and celebrates noticing, including "not sure yet" and "it's okay just as it is."

Good to know

Questions about Body Clues

When will Body Clues be available?
We're finishing Body Clues now. Email info@cultivate-play.com and we'll let you know as soon as it's ready.
What is interoception?
Interoception is the sense that tells us what's happening inside our bodies, like hunger, a racing heart, needing the bathroom or feeling tired. Noticing these signals helps us understand our emotions and needs and figure out what helps.
Who is Body Clues for?
Kids, teens and adults, including neurodivergent people who are still learning to read their body's signals. Parents, therapists and teachers can set it up for someone they support, or use it alongside them.
Where is my family's information kept?
Check-ins are saved on your family's own device, not on our servers. You can save a backup file to move them to another phone or tablet, and a care team summary is only shared when you choose to send it.
Does Body Clues replace therapy?
No. Body Clues is a tool for noticing and learning, not a diagnosis or a substitute for therapy. Many families find it helpful to bring their patterns to sessions with their occupational therapist, speech therapist or counselor.
